sourceText:
Viili
By: Minttu
Published: Wednesday, May 25, 2011 - 4:09am

Ingredients




viili starter culture
full milk
cream

Preparation

1 Buy a ready made jar of viili (or starter culture) 2 Take a tablespoon of it and mix it in a serving bowl full of lukewarm milk (no fat free milk here), and a drop of cream, if you want a creamy top (the best part, I always think). 3 Leave this mix in room temperature, covered, for 24 hours and you have yourself a soft and silky, milky treat. 4 Top with fresh berries, jam, sugar and cinnamon, rice krispies, satsumas etc...

About


Milk mixed with milk bacteria, which makes it sour and thick. A bit like yogurt, but not really. As with other milk bacteria products, viili also has a soothing effect on your stomach.
